title: Unforgeable evidence — gate on signed evidence an agent cannot produce without the human

acceptance_criteria.given: a base ref with attestation.require_signature true and a signer in its allowed_signers file
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate reads an attestation whose payload carries a valid signature by that signer for this repo, pull request and head

tests.name: verifies an attestation signed by a base-ref allowed signer

acceptance_criteria.given: a base ref with attestation.require_signature true
acceptance_criteria.when: the only attestation comment from a trusted author carries no signature, or a signature that does not verify
acceptance_criteria.then: the gate blocks with EVIDENCE_UNSIGNED or EVIDENCE_SIGNATURE_INVALID

tests.name: blocks an unsigned attestation when signatures are required
blocks an attestation whose signature does not verify

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request that adds a new key to the allowed_signers file at its head only
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate verifies evidence signed by that new key
acceptance_criteria.then: the gate blocks with EVIDENCE_SIGNER_UNKNOWN, because signers are read from the base ref

tests.name: reads allowed signers from the base ref, never the head

acceptance_criteria.given: a validly signed payload for another repository, pull request, or head SHA
acceptance_criteria.when: it is posted on this pull request
acceptance_criteria.then: the gate blocks with EVIDENCE_SIGNATURE_SCOPE, so a signature cannot be replayed

tests.name: refuses a signature replayed from another repository, pull request, or head

acceptance_criteria.given: a base ref without require_signature, or with it false
acceptance_criteria.when: the gate reads an unsigned marker comment from a trusted author
acceptance_criteria.then: the gate behaves exactly as before this spec, and a signed comment is accepted too

tests.name: accepts unsigned and signed evidence while signatures are not required

acceptance_criteria.given: require_signature true for criteria evidence and for review-complete evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate and pr-stack entry read an unsigned comment of either family
acceptance_criteria.then: criteria evidence blocks with EVIDENCE_UNSIGNED and pr-stack entry does not skip the review stage

tests.name: requires a signature on criteria evidence
does not skip the review stage on unsigned review-complete evidence

acceptance_criteria.given: a configured signing key that is a plain file readable by the current user and is not a security-key (sk) key
acceptance_criteria.then: doctor warns EVIDENCE_KEY_AGENT_READABLE, because a signature from that key proves nothing about who signed

tests.name: warns when the signing key is readable by the agent's user

acceptance_criteria.given: the CI test workflow with require_signature true on the base ref
acceptance_criteria.when: a trusted comment carries the attestation marker for the head without a valid signature
acceptance_criteria.then: the remote test job runs instead of skipping

tests.name: test workflow skips only on a signature-verified attestation
